pipeline.summary: Clinical research company nPhase has launched an end-to-end clinical data management platform designed to help trial sponsors leverage trial results with AI.

pipeline.title: BioMarin pads case for Voxzogo expansion as achondroplasia competition field shifts

pipeline.title: Tyra rolls toward pivotal bladder cancer study even as midphase data deflates stock

pipeline.title: Abbott garners FDA nod for its TactiFlex catheter to treat AFib
pipeline.summary: Abbot received FDA clearance for its latest-generation catheter that allows physicians more flexibility when treating atrial fibrillation in patients.

pipeline.title: Beeline flies into phase 3 as oral lupus drug soars past placebo
pipeline.summary: A phase 2 trial of Beeline Medicines’ afimetoran has hit its primary endpoint, positioning the biotech to swarm into pivotal development in two forms of lupus.

pipeline.title: Solstice rises with $225M series A to advance next-gen CTLA-4 immunotherapy into phase 2
pipeline.summary: Solstice Oncology has secured $225 million in series A funding to advance a next-gen immunotherapy that the biotech hopes will turn “darkness to light” for cancer care.

pipeline.title: Eight Trends Reshaping Patient-Centric Drug Development

pipeline.title: Novo Nordisk’s Wegovy helps free 40% of kids from obesity in phase 3 trial
pipeline.summary: Novo Nordisk has reported a phase 3 weight-management win for Wegovy in children, with two out of five kids no longer classified as having obesity after receiving the GLP-1 drug for 68 weeks.

pipeline.title: FDA approves AstraZeneca’s Etcamah, opening ctDNA-guided treatment paradigm in breast cancer

pipeline.title: Is Moderna, Merck's mRNA cancer vaccine win the start of a 'personalized medicine revolution'?

pipeline.title: After FDA nod for novel Cabometyx formulation, analysts predict limited threat to Exelixis
pipeline.summary: Following formal sign-off from the FDA, Handa Pharmaceuticals’ branded drug reformulation strategy has paid off for a third time.

pipeline.title: This week in charts: RA’s insatiable appetite, Novartis’ big slide and a reverse merger spree

pipeline.title: The future of RAS inhibitors

pipeline.title: FDA delays approval decision for Exelixis' tyrosine kinase inhibitor in colorectal cancer
pipeline.summary: The FDA has delayed its approval decision for Exelixis’ oral kinase inhibitor in combination with Roche’s Tecentriq for the treatment of metastatic colorectal cancer.

pipeline.summary: Takeda's long-time R&D chief Andy Plump will retire. Daiichi Sankyo beat back a $1.3 billion damage claim in a lawsuit. Samsung Biologics signed a $262 million contract with an unnamed client. And more.

pipeline.title: CDMO Argonaut sheds life sciences, diagnostics division for undisclosed sum
pipeline.summary: Argonaut Manufacturing Services, a CDMO specializing in aseptic fill-finish for injectable biologics and other drugs, has sold its life sciences and diagnostics unit to the private equity firm 1315 Capital for an undisclosed price.

pipeline.title: mRNA cancer vaccines’ biggest barriers to market
pipeline.summary: Manufacturing hurdles are just one challenge the industry must overcome to commercialize personalized mRNA cancer vaccines.

pipeline.title: In first interview as FDA oncology chief, Angelo de Claro vows to ‘continue the innovation’ behind OCE legacy
pipeline.summary: In his first interview after taking the reins of the FDA’s Oncology Center of Excellence, Angelo de Claro, M.D., is outlining a regulatory agenda that prioritizes organizational strength and continued regulatory modernization.

pipeline.title: Singapore launches biotech-focused Boston hub to build on 'centuries-old bond'
pipeline.summary: Officials rubbed shoulders with business leaders in a 19th-floor meeting room to celebrate the launch of Singapore’s newest Overseas Centre.

pipeline.title: Scientists boycott American Diabetes Association as fallout of June conference fracas escalates
pipeline.summary: Following the removal of five scientists from its annual conference in June, members of the American Diabetes Association have launched a boycott of the organization that includes halting the review of grants and new articles submitted to the ADA’s flagship journal, Diabetes Care

pipeline.title: Chutes & Ladders—Longtime Takeda R&D chief to depart next June
pipeline.summary: Takeda President of Research and Development Andy Plump, M.D., Ph.D., is leaving the company in June after twelve years in the position.

pipeline.title: FDA places partial hold on Biohaven’s epilepsy drug
pipeline.summary: Announced mere weeks after Biohaven sold off rights to the therapy, opakalim, the halt affects a study some analysts believe is necessary to support a potential approval.

pipeline.title: Swiss CDMOs making moves: Lonza bets on new US facility, CordenPharma scales injectables with €80M
pipeline.summary: Lonza's plans for a new spray-drying facility in Bend, Oregon, affirm the company's commitment both to high-margin medicines and the U.S. At the same time, fellow Swiss CDMO CordenPharma is also making expansion moves, albeit closer to home.

pipeline.title: Andy Plump, architect of Takeda’s R&D overhaul, to retire next year
pipeline.summary: Plump joined Takeda during a turbulent period, pushed the company to work more closely with young biotechs and will leave it with what CEO Julie Kim called a “lasting foundation.”

pipeline.title: In draft guidance, NICE rebuffs Gilead's twice-a-year PrEP med for national coverage
pipeline.summary: In a move that at least one local HIV charity has deemed “profoundly disappointing,” England's health technology assessor NICE is currently recommending against coverage of Gilead Sciences’ landmark twice-a-year PrEP medication, lenacapavir, on the National Health Service.

pipeline.title: Novartis shareholder calls for board overhaul following costly deal setbacks: Reuters
pipeline.summary: Novartis’ recent dual clinical setbacks have prompted questions from a major shareholder about the board’s oversight of dealmaking.

pipeline.title: Biohaven epilepsy drug suffers FDA hold days after attracting $350M deal
pipeline.summary: The FDA has put enrollment in trials of Biohaven’s epilepsy drug candidate BHV-7000 on hold in response to findings from rodent tests, dealing a blow to an asset covered by a pending $350 million deal.

pipeline.title: Frazier Life Sciences nets $1.1B in long-running fund aimed at small, midsize biotechs
pipeline.summary: Frazier Life Sciences (FLS) has stacked up another sizable biotech-focused capital commitment, netting more than $1.1 billion for its long-running public fund.

pipeline.title: Takeda’s long-serving R&D chief Andy Plump to retire in wake of pipeline successes
pipeline.summary: Andy Plump, M.D., Ph.D., president of research and development at Takeda, is set to leave the company in June.

pipeline.title: A booming business on Wall Street would love more biotechs to quietly die
pipeline.summary: Once disparaged, reverse mergers have become so popular that some deal experts question whether there are enough quality shell companies to meet the demand.

pipeline.title: Samsung Bio, waiting to break into peptides, nets $262M manufacturing deal with unnamed EU pharma
pipeline.summary: As Samsung Biologics works to close a massive buyout to branch out into peptides, the Korean CDMO’s bread-and-butter contracting work continues to gin up big-ticket contracts from the drug industry.

pipeline.title: Mass. governor makes pre-election pitch to biotechs amid warning early-stage start-ups are 'dying'
pipeline.summary: It may have seemed like an ordinary Wednesday afternoon at MassBio’s headquarters in Technology Square, but the black SUV parked outside was a telltale sign that the Cambridge, Massachusetts-based biotech trade group was playing host to a government official.

pipeline.title: Sanofi hits the pickleball court in education push for COVID vax Nuvaxovid
pipeline.summary: The "Serve Up Protection" Nuvaxovid education campaign will take place on and off the court, Sanofi said.

pipeline.title: FDA clears Bayer’s Hyrnuo in first-line lung cancer, amping up Hernexeos rivalry
pipeline.summary: Bayer has won first-line approval for its tyrosine kinase inhibitor, Hyrnuo, in patients with HER2-mutant non-small cell lung cancer. The green light comes around half a year after a similar nod for rival TKI med Hernexeos from Boehringer Ingelheim.

pipeline.title: Actor Kevin Costner does the math in Caris Detect early cancer detection push
pipeline.summary: The 60-second ad sees "Yellowstone" actor Kevin Costner doing the math on the benefits of early cancer detection with Caris' Caris Detect blood test.

pipeline.title: Kura spins diabetes work into a Lilly-backed biotech startup
pipeline.summary: Caspian Therapeutics aims to develop menin inhibitors, which have proven effective against leukemia, for diabetes and other cardiometabolic conditions.

pipeline.title: FDA gains ‘continuity’ as Mikhail, Davis named permanent CBER, CDER leaders
pipeline.summary: After almost two years of turnover in the FDA’s top ranks, the new appointments should help ease concerns about more turmoil ahead, one analyst said.

pipeline.title: Merck trims another 54 jobs in New Jersey amid multiyear cost-cutting initiative
pipeline.summary: Merck continues sweeping staff reductions, laying off 54 at its Rahway headquarters. The staff changes are set to take effect in December and January.

pipeline.title: Precision Medicine Has a Commercialization Problem
pipeline.summary: As drug discovery is revolutionized by AI, the machinery built to get life-saving medicines to market remains trapped in a different era. Here’s how we solve that.

pipeline.title: Luma locks down 15-year, $410M fund for life science investments
pipeline.summary: Luma Group announced the final close of its inaugural life sciences venture capital fund totaling $410 million.

pipeline.title: GV-backed Encoded gains $275M to advance Dravet drug, scale genetic med manufacturing
pipeline.summary: Neuro-focused Encoded Therapeutics has bagged a $275 million series F round to support its Dravet syndrome asset and scale up its internal manufacturing capabilities.

pipeline.title: FDA solidifies CDER, CBER leadership posts as commissioner confirmation awaits
pipeline.summary: In a stabilizing move, the Department of Health and Human Services announced Tuesday afternoon that it has tapped Michael Davis, M.D., Ph.D., and Karim Mikhail—who’ve been serving as acting directors of CDER and CBER, respectively—to occupy their posts on a permanent basis.

pipeline.title: Kura creates Lilly-backed spinout armed with $50M to advance next-gen diabetes therapy
pipeline.summary: Kura Oncology has spun out a biotech armed with $50 million in fresh funding to take forward a next-generation diabetes treatment.

pipeline.title: A new immuno-oncology play raises $225M for a next-generation drug
pipeline.summary: Solstice Oncology is advancing a medicine from China’s Harbour BioMed that it believes is able to address the weaknesses of drugs aimed at CTLA-4, a popular but tricky cancer immunotherapy target.

pipeline.title: Labcorp snaps up MLM Medical Labs to boost laboratory footprint
pipeline.summary: Medtech and testing giant Labcorp has bought out MLM Medical Labs to help grow its geographic footprint for laboratory services.

pipeline.title: Schrödinger births new immunology and inflammation biotech, Tectora Therapeutics
pipeline.summary: Schrödinger announced the launch of new immune disease-focused Tectora Therapeutics, which comes online with a $55 million series A financing round.

pipeline.title: Sandoz sets sights on 100 biosimilars in new 2040 strategy, with $300M facility build
pipeline.summary: Spying a “golden decade” beyond the branded drug industry’s looming patent cliff, Sandoz is making big bets on its biosimilar capabilities in the coming years.

pipeline.title: Amgen’s DLL3-targeted Imdelltra scores overall survival win in first-line small cell lung cancer
pipeline.summary: While Amgen gave no numerical results from Imdelltra's latest overall survival win in first-line small cell lung cancer, R&D chief Jay Bradner said data suggest the DLL3 bispecific “will further revolutionize the standard for survival earlier in the treatment journey.”

pipeline.title: Drug pricing policy ‘earthquake’ forcing rethink of global commercialization plans: survey
pipeline.summary: Shifts in drug pricing and market access policies around the world have caused an “earthquake” that will reverberate for years to come, a survey of industry leaders found.

pipeline.title: UCB turns to art for ‘Expressing Epilepsy’ awareness campaign
pipeline.summary: Belgian biopharma UCB is seeking to boost awareness of what epilepsy looks like to patients, literally, with a new campaign using art to tell their stories.

pipeline.title: Ardelyx launches first connected TV ad for GI drug Ibsrela
pipeline.summary: Ardelyx is running a new ad campaign for its irritable bowel syndrome with constipation drug, Ibsrela, across connected TV.

pipeline.title: The Oral GLP-1 Tracker: Novo's Wegovy pill, Lilly's Foundayo continue prescription climb
pipeline.summary: Fierce Pharma is launching the weekly Oral GLP-1 Tracker, leveraging analysts’ notes and IQVIA data to monitor prescription trends and shifting market shares as Novo Nordisk's Wegovy pill and Eli Lilly's Foundayo vie to become the go-to oral weight-loss solution for millions.

pipeline.title: Fierce Biotech Layoff Tracker 2026: Merck trims more NJ jobs; Novartis nixes Swiss site
pipeline.summary: As always, if you know of layoffs occurring at a biotech, please reach out to the Fierce Biotech editorial team.

pipeline.title: Fierce Biotech Fundraising Tracker '26: Encoded finagles $275M series F; Solstice rises with $225M
pipeline.summary: The Fierce Biotech Fundraising Tracker records venture capital rounds of $50 million or more secured by biotechs.
